Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/ndpi && python3 -c "
import struct
f = open('tests/pcap/tls-rdn-extract.pcap','rb')
data = f.read()
# pcap global header
magic = struct.unpack('<I', data[0:4])[0]
if magic == 0xa1b2c3d4:
    endian = '<'
else:
    endian = '>'
off = 24
pktnum = 0
while off < len(data):
    ts_sec, ts_usec, incl_len, orig_len = struct.unpack(endian+'IIII', data[off:off+16])
    off += 16
    pkt = data[off:off+incl_len]
    off += incl_len
    pktnum += 1
    # parse ethernet (14) + ipv4 (20) + tcp (20)
    if len(pkt) < 54: continue
    eth = pkt[0:14]
    ihl = (pkt[14] & 0x0f)*4
    proto = pkt[23]
    if proto != 6: continue
    tcp_off = 14+ihl
    doff = (pkt[tcp_off+12] >> 4)*4
    payload = pkt[tcp_off+doff:]
    # find TLS records
    i = 0
    while i < len(payload)-4:
        if payload[i] in (0x16,0x17,0x14,0x15):
            ct = payload[i]
            ver = payload[i+1:i+3]
            ln = struct.unpack('>H', payload[i+3:i+5])[0]
            rec = payload[i:i+5+ln]
            if ct == 0x16 and ln > 0:
                # handshake
                hs_type = rec[5]
                hs_len = struct.unpack('>I', b'\x00'+rec[6:9])[0]
                print(f'pkt {pktnum} TLS handshake type={hs_type} hs_len={hs_len} rec_len={ln}')
                if hs_type == 0x0b:
                    print('  CERTIFICATE found, body:', rec[5:5+hs_len+4].hex())
            i += 5+ln
        else:
            i += 1
" 2>&1 | head -40` executed with exit code 0.
